test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: K, L, M, W, X, Y and Z scored different marks in an exam. K scored more than only three people. Y scored less than only L and M. W scored more than Z but less than X. L did not score the highest marks. How many people scored less than X?
solution:
**Given: **K, L, M, W, X, Y and Z scored different marks in an exam. 

1) K scored more than only three people. 

_ > _ > _ > K > _ > _ > _

2) Y scored less than only L and M. 

L/M > L/M > Y > K > _ > _ > _

3) W scored more than Z but less than X.

L/M > L/M > Y > K > X > W > Z

4) L did not score the highest marks.

M > L > Y > K > X > W > Z

Thus, according to the final arrangement two people scored less than X.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
